map.输入已知边 b、其对角 B 与待求边对角 A（度），求边长 a。: Enter the known side b, its opposite angle B, and the angle A opposite the unknown side (degrees) to find side a.

map.正弦定理用于解斜三角形。: The law of sines is used to solve oblique triangles.
map.已知两角一边求其余边（AAS/ASA）: Find the remaining sides from two angles and one side (AAS/ASA)
map.已知两边及其中一边的对角求角（SSA，可能两解）: Find an angle from two sides and the angle opposite one of them (SSA, possibly two solutions)
map.已知 a,b 及角 A（SSA）时可能无解、一解或两解，因为 sin 在 0~1: Given a, b, and angle A (SSA), there may be no solution, one solution, or two, because sin is symmetric over 0~180°; use the figure to decide.
map.a/sinA=b/sinB=c/sinC=2R（R 为外接圆半径）。即边与其对角: a/sinA=b/sinB=c/sinC=2R (R is the circumradius). That is, each side is proportional to the sine of its opposite angle.
map.为什么 SSA 会有两解？: Why can SSA have two solutions?
map.因为 sinθ=sin(180°-θ)，给定一边对角后，另一角可能取锐角或补角，: Because sinθ=sin(180°−θ); once one side and its opposite angle are fixed, the other angle may be acute or the supplement, giving two different triangles (unless excluded by a side constraint).
